Home.aboutQuote: “The playbill is a map of commitments.”
Home.aboutBody: For over two decades, Hendrik Flacke has operated at the structural heart of German and international theatre. His approach integrates the physical rigor of acting with the architectural demands of directing and script authorship—building singular theatrical worlds defined by intellectual challenge and raw, unvarnished human truth.
